FIRoadWeather 0.2.0 (versionCode 2) — internal test track

Fixes from the first drive in the car, 2026-09-22.

* The position now follows the car. v0.1.0 resolved it once at launch and
  showed the same road for a whole commute. Location updates run while the
  screen is visible and the data reloads once the car has moved 2 km.
* Finnish and Swedish text where there was English. The app now tells the
  backend which language to serve, so "clear" becomes "selkeää" and the road
  condition arrives translated.
* A faulty roadside sensor no longer shows as a road condition. "The sensor
  has a fault" appeared where "Kuiva" belongs, under a reassuring ice line.
  It now reads as unavailable.
* Station names are readable: vt3_Helsinki_Pirkkola -> Vt 3 Helsinki Pirkkola.
* Clearer wording when a road-section forecast has no station behind it.
